tools.name: authenticity_check

tools.name: ira_eligibility_check
tools.description: Check whether a bullion product can be held in a US precious-metals IRA under IRC 408(m): the catalog's recorded determination first, otherwise the statutory fineness rules with the American Eagle exception.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_product_feed · Private data: dealer_trust_check · Public sink: get_market_freshness_index · Destructive: calculate_budget_stack, get_premium_index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_product_feed · Private data: dealer_trust_check · Public sink: get_market_freshness_index · Destructive: calculate_budget_stack, get_premium_index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_bullion_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search and filter OunceScout's canonical gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion catalog (coins, bars, rounds) with lowest verified dealer prices and multi-dealer offer counts." → after: "Search and filter OunceScout's canonical gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion catalog (coins, bars, rounds) with lowest verified dealer prices and multi-dealer offer counts. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
